params.name: createdDate
params.description:
The date and timestamp when the entity was created.
Search using range method, e.g. createdDate=range(date1,date2).

params.name: category
params.description:
The code that represents the category of the notification.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. category=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: type
params.description:
The code that represents the type of notification.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. type=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: senderEmail
params.description:
The email address of the Sender.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. senderEmail=email1,email2,email3.

params.name: senderFirstName
params.description:
The first name of the Sender.
Search using contains method, e.g. senderFirstName=contains(astring).

params.name: senderLastName
params.description:
The last name of the Sender.
Search using contains method, e.g. senderLastName=contains(astring).

params.name: companyName
params.description:
Name of the company the Sender belongs to.
Search using contains method, e.g. companyName=contains(astring).

params.name: recipientEmail
params.description:
The email address of the Recipient.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. recipientEmail=email1,email2,email3.

params.name: recipientFirstName
params.description:
The first name of the Recipient.
Search using contains method, e.g. recipientFirstName=contains(astring).

params.name: recipientLastName
params.description:
The last name of the Recipient.
Search using contains method, e.g. recipientLastName=contains(astring).

params.name: recipientTeamId
params.description:
The Team ID of the team the Recipient belongs to. A system-generated unique identifier for a Team, with a format and structure defined by the technology used. 
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. recipientTeamId=team1,team2,team3.

params.name: recipientTeamName
params.description:
The name of the Team the Recipient belongs to.
Search using contains method, e.g. recipientTeamName=contains(astring).

params.name: isTechnical
params.description:
Indicates whether the Notification is related to a technical event  (true) or a business event (false).
Search using single exact match method, e.g. isTechnical=true/false.

params.name: processStatus
params.description:
The code that represents the status of a technical, asynchronous event.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. processStatus=code1,code2,code3.

params.name: expiryDate
params.description:
The date and timestamp by which the Subjectivity needs to be met or the deadline date for the Report.
Search using range method, e.g. expiryDate=range(date1,date2).

params.name: clientName
params.description:
The name by which the Broker User knows the client for the purposes of seeking insurance.
Search using contains method, e.g. clientName=contains(astring).

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorting field and order (unique field only).
Use + before the field name for ascending order, use - for descending order.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Number of the page to be retrieved.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Size of the page to be retrieved.
